narrative_shape: Extraction wait, then results, then a second wait, then a commit. Turn 75 is parked on a full-Australia run after the module was already rewritten (Edit 10, the extractor reread 6 times). Turn 90 says the run results are in and done-evidence has started. Turns 100–102 wait on a pytest monitor. Turn 105 stages owned files and commits. Both waits resolve inside the prefix.

phases.name: wait on full extraction
phases.note: Reviews the module while a monitor watches the Australia run. Explicitly stops polling.

phases.name: results arrive
phases.note: Monitor re-armed during index finalization (spool ~19GB). Turn 90: full results, done-evidence, commit prep.

phases.name: suite wait, then commit
phases.note: Monitor on pytest plus grep/git checks. Turn 105: owned files staged, committing.

early_signals.signal: Names the full-Australia extraction and defers the final time numbers until the monitor fires.
Switches to the Monitor notification instead of polling.
Results are in; done-evidence and commit prep start — the extraction wait resolved.
Second wait, on the suite monitor, rather than polling further.

rationale: The ≤120 window already contains both waits and the commit. The waits are on-brief evidence steps that finish. That is not early thrash and not a pivot that fails to return.
